args.title: Change aria-live to assertive for toast messages
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update the aria-live property from 'polite' to 'assertive' and ensure that error messages remain visible until dismissed.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The aria-live attribute currently used is set to 'polite', which delays announcements for screen readers. This change will improve accessibility.
